messages:
maya: Heads-up: PR #987 can't be merged — arch says RFC needed for kv-cache routing changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/987 RFC: https://r.rw/rfc/426-kv-cache-routing. Can someone from arch take a quick look? cc @arik

sam: :eyes: saw this. The change routes requests to shard-level caches differently; if we switch fallback behavior it could affect latency. @arik any immediate blockers?

arik: Thanks @maya. I skimmed the RFC. A few questions before I can sign off: 1) how does this interact with prefix caching (L1 vs L2)? 2) rollback plan if evictions spike? 3) perf regression test plan?

maya: Answers: 1) We'll keep prefix caching unchanged — this only changes request routing when model variant mismatch occurs. 2) Rollback is a runtime flag `routing.v2.enabled=false` + canary to 10% then 100%. 3) Added perf job in ci: `tests/perf/kv_routing_bench` — ran on p4 and a100 with 95th latency baseline attached in PR.

jordan: Can you paste the rollback flag snippet? Need to add to our runbooks.

maya: Snippet:
```yaml
runtime:
  routing:
    v2:
      enabled: true
      canary_pct: 10
```
We'll add runbook entry in the PR.

ci-bot: CI: perf-tests passed (p4: baseline delta +0.4%), unit tests passed, integration flaky on one case, rerunning.

arik: Okay helps. Last ask: add a short section in the RFC about consistency guarantees when routing to variant vs fallback. Then I can +1. Also drop a link to the canary dashboard once available.

maya: Will update RFC and PR today. Thanks! :thumbsup:

sam: I'll hold merge until arch +1. ping me when done and I'll queue merge.

maya: Updated RFC: https://r.rw/rfc/426-kv-cache-routing#consistency. Also added canary dashboard link: https://dash.rw/canaries/kv-routing-987. @arik can you review when you have 30m?

arik: Reviewing now. Quick note: please add expected token-level cost delta to the RFC so SRE/fin can assess.

maya: Done — added `estimated_cost_delta: 0.002 tokens/req` and rationale.

arik: +1 from me after those edits. :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks — merging blocked tag removed when arch signoff present. Will merge after CI green.
